name: Arcadia Beta
desc:
Welcome to Arcadia! 🏹

Can you beat every floor? Shop for items, complete quests, level up with your friends!
Guilds coming soon

How to play:
(Q) to Equip swords
(F) to Dash

This game is in beta testing, join the group to stay updated!

scripts.title: attack aura
scripts.features: attacks any enemy nearby as long as you got a sword
scripts.script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    character = localPlayer.Character
    local target = nil
    local distance = 100
    local tool
    for _,v in character:GetChildren() do
        if v:FindFirstChild("Damage") then
            tool = v
        end
    end
    if tool then
        for _,v in workspace:GetChildren() do
            if v:FindFirstChild("Mob") and v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position - character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < distance then
                distance = (v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position - character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
                target = v
            end
        end
    end
    if target then
        tool.Damage:FireServer(target)
    end
end)
